about: Caller-class registry for v1.signer `sign` predecessors (METHOD-b §5). Rules apply in order; the first match wins. An account matching no rule is class 5 (unattributed). Status: confirmed = seen at the owner's or an official source; reported = someone else's claim, or a tie resting on a block-explorer label or an account-name lead plus a confirmed fact. Researchers' notes with every search tried: registry/sources-1.md, sources-2.md, sources-3.md. Raw copies of explorer responses: ~/Data/hackathons/near-2026/best-price-sources-2026-11-09/callers/.

namespace_rule.text: Accounts cannot create sub-accounts of other accounts; bob.near can create sub-accounts of itself, such as app.bob.near.
namespace_rule.use: A sub-account was created by its parent's owner, so it inherits the parent's attribution at creation. It says nothing about who controls it later; the rules below use it only where the parent is attributed.
